function: Learned power control and subcarrier allocation for UAV and LEO downlinks, jointly with user association and UAV placement, for SAGIN slicing with load balancing (p. 8).
system: Downlink SAGIN: 2 BSs, 2 UAVs, 1 LEO satellite; antennas not stated; no RIS; 30 MHz, 10 subcarriers per node type; carrier frequency not given (p. 3, 9).
method: Two-layer MADDPG with three agents per layer (one per slice), actor-critic DNNs, trained by reinforcement learning with experience replay; relaxed binary actions are rounded (p. 7-9).
data_channel: Simulated Rayleigh (BS), Rician (UAV) and free-space (LEO) links, random user positions in 3000 x 3000 m; no standardized or measured channel (p. 3-4, 9).
test_conditions: Single simulated topology (M=2, V=2, O=1); users per slice swept from 8 to 16 (p. 9-12); the paper does not say whether agents are retrained per point.
baselines: Non-learned: Benchmark 1 random disconnection, Benchmark 2 no load balancing, Benchmark 5 fixed UAV positions; learned: single-layer MADDPG and MAPPO (p. 9, 11-12).
metrics: Slice throughput (H), average delay (L), coverage percentage (C), reward convergence, per-BS and per-UAV load (p. 5-6, 9-11).
q1_support: p. 3: "modeled as classic Rayleigh fading channel" for BS links, with Rician fading for UAV links; p. 4: "which suffers free space loss" for LEO links. Custom simulated channels; no 3GPP TR 38.811 or other standard model, no measured data.
q2_support: p. 10: "versus the number of users on each slice". Only users per slice are swept in one simulated topology (p. 9); the paper does not state testing in an unseen scenario or whether agents are retrained per point.
q3_support: p. 9: "relying on six parallel distributed Agents" (Benchmarks 3 and 4, single-layer MADDPG and MAPPO); "users are randomly disconnected with the BS" (Benchmark 1); "scheme, where the positions of the UAVs are fixed at" (Benchmark 5).
q4_support: p. 6: "sub-problems to reduce the complexity". Qualitative only; no order of complexity, operations, parameters or runtime is reported.
q5_support: p. 9: "the users are randomly distributed with". Users and channels are simulated; no public dataset, code or data link is given.
notes: Include, area 6. above_phy passes through the aerial and satellite exception: the MADDPG actions include power control and subcarrier allocation for UAV and LEO links, jointly with association and UAV position (p. 8: "satellite association, subcarrier allocation and power control"). Borderline: most of the paper is slicing and load balancing, which is above the physical layer. NTN admits single-antenna links, and antennas are not stated. q3 rests on Benchmarks 1, 2 and 5 being simple non-learned configurations; they modify one module of the proposed scheme, so the reviewer should confirm. PDF has no journal header; same title.
